title: Zhiyuan Robotics Enters the Multimodal Tactile Perception Field, Invests in Leading R&D Company Mogan Technology

content_html:
Zhiyuan Robotics has recently made another move in the embodied intelligence industry chain. According to Tianyancha and business change information, Mogan (Shanghai) Technology Co., Ltd. has recently undergone a business change, adding Zhiyuan Innovation (Shanghai) Science and Technology Co., Ltd., an affiliated company of Zhiyuan Robotics, as a shareholder, while the company's registered capital has increased to 1.1774 million yuan.

As a new technology company established in May 2026, Mogan Technology's business scope covers areas such as network and information security software development. In its core business, the company focuses on the research and development and manufacturing of electromagnetic metamaterial flexible electronic skin, multi-modal fusion perception systems, and tactile-integrated robots. Its exploration in tactile perception underlying technologies aligns with the urgent demand for precise tactile interaction in the humanoid robot industry.

This investment is not the first move by Zhiyuan Robotics in the industrial ecosystem. Tracing its investment and cooperation path, it can be seen that Zhiyuan Robotics is accelerating the commercialization of embodied intelligence. Previously, Zhiyuan Robotics not only invested in the embodied intelligence company Zhishen Technology in November 2025, but also signed a strategic cooperation order worth hundreds of millions of yuan with Longqi Technology. Meanwhile, in the supply chain and manufacturing sectors, Zhiyuan has collaborated with several companies to invest in a new company under Huatian Electronics, and has reached a cooperation agreement with Lens Technology, which will undertake the production of Zhiyuan's entire series of multiple humanoid robots, further solidifying its industrial closed loop from core component R&D to mass production.
